result.title: Sector-Ring Linear Reservoirs: Sector-Wise Decay-Timescale Allocation With State Reuse Across Candidate Settings
result.comment: 19 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to IEEE Access
result.summary: In reservoir computing, performance depends on whether the fixed dynamics of the reservoir suit the task, and the appropriate memory length and frequency response differ across tasks. The reservoir settings are found by a search on each task, and driving the reservoir with the input and collecting its states for every candidate setting dominates the cost of the search. In a reservoir with a linear recurrence, the dynamics decompose into modes, one per eigenvalue, and the eigenvalue distribution becomes a design variable. We propose the Sector-Ring Linear Reservoir (SRLR), in which the eigenvalue angles are fixed at evenly spaced positions around a circle and one decay timescale, chosen from a few values, is assigned to each sector of consecutive angles. To keep the scale of each mode's state equal across candidates, the input weights are scaled using the power spectrum of the training input. To reduce the cost of the search, the states of the modes for each decay-timescale value are computed once and reused across candidates. On prediction and reconstruction benchmarks built from chaotic systems, the SRLR achieved, in all eight cases, a lower mean test error than a reference model in which all modes share one decay timescale, and was competitive with nonlinear echo state network and leaky-integrator echo state network baselines. The selected decay-timescale profiles changed with the prediction target and horizon. The state reuse reduced the number of computed mode trajectories in the search by 99.8% relative to per-candidate recomputation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Sector-Ring 线性储备池：把特征值角度固定在圆周等距位置，按角度扇区分配少数几个衰减时间尺度作为设计变量，并用训练输入功率谱缩放输入权重以保持各模式状态尺度一致；通过复用各时间尺度的模式轨迹降低候选设置搜索成本。在混沌系统预测与重构基准上，平均测试误差均优于共享单一衰减时间尺度的参照模型，且所选时间尺度轮廓随预测目标与步长变化，轨迹复用使搜索中需计算的模式轨迹数减少 99.8%。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按候选设置复用已计算的模式状态」与线性递推的模式分解、扇区化时间尺度分配，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹缓存复用、候选评估成本与循环计算的记忆长度控制提供可核查的方法线索，但该工作属储备池与时间序列领域，与视觉多模态推理相距较远。
